translation_notes: context shim: supermodel_shim.py replaces the pylode imports (pylode/__init__.py needs `dominate`, absent here). It carries LODE verbatim from pylode/profiles/supermodel/namespace.py plus DemoQuery, a stand-in for Query restricted to what the region touches (self.db, self.imported_profiles, and add_to_graph copied verbatim from lines 330-333 of the same file).

demo harness added identically to both sides: the region is a RECURSIVE method (self.import_profile(...)), so the harness entry= path cannot call it - `self` would have to carry the right modules function. Both files end with the same 5-line __demo__ section binding the function onto DemoQuery, running it from a root profile, and leaving imported_graph (isomorphism) + a printed quad/graph-name report (stdout) as module state.

two tiny Turtle artifacts, profile-a.ttl (a prof:Profile) and profile-b.ttl (an owl:Ontology, and a qualified profile of profile-a), exercise both branches of the profile_iri lookup and the recursive call

all eight namespace terms become prefixed names: LODE.isQualifiedProfileOf -> lode:isQualifiedProfileOf, RDF.value / PROF.hasResource -> rdf:value / prof:hasResource (the rdflib property path survives unchanged between two islands), PROF.hasArtifact, DCTERMS.format, RDF.type, PROF.Profile, OWL.Ontology
the auto-generated draft placed the @prefix block right after the pylode import; it is now a block of its own after all imports, and only the five prefixes actually used are declared
note: graph.parse(path, mimetype) passes the mimetype as rdflibs publicID, not as format - a latent bug in the original that the translation preserves verbatim
